Layers.StatisticsHint.zh: 总计：当前编辑文档的三个画布中的图形、普通组和共享实例（实例计为一层）。本级：当前列表中的直接子层。已选：当前选中的图层。
Layers.StatisticsHint.en: Total: shapes, groups and shared instances across the editing document's three canvases (each instance counts once). This level: direct children in this list. Selected: current layer selection.

Layers.EmptyScope.zh: {0}暂无图层。使用上方路径或画布菜单切换范围。
Layers.EmptyScope.en: No layers in {0}. Use the path or canvas menu above to navigate.

Layers.Processed.zh: 已处理 {0} 项，跳过 {1} 项。

GroupCanvas.SwitchIndependent.zh:
独立画布 · 点击切换工程预览
仅显示当前编辑范围
GroupCanvas.SwitchIndependent.en:
Independent canvas · Click for project preview
Show only the current editing scope

GroupCanvas.SwitchProject.zh:
工程预览 · 点击切换独立画布
显示完整工程，仅编辑当前范围
GroupCanvas.SwitchProject.en:
Project preview · Click for independent canvas
Show the full project; edit only the current scope

GroupCanvas.LinkedNotice.zh: 只读浏览。转为内嵌后保留工程内共享关系；解除后成为普通组。
GroupCanvas.LinkedNotice.en: Read-only view. Embed to retain sharing within this project; detach to make an ordinary group.

Layers.InvalidTarget.zh: 目标已锁定，或会形成循环层级。
Layers.InvalidTarget.en: The destination is locked or would create a cycle.

Layers.CrossCanvasNotice.zh: 保留逻辑坐标；跨透视平面移动可能改变屏幕位置与外观。
Layers.CrossCanvasNotice.en: Logical coordinates are retained; moving between projection planes may change screen position and appearance.

Layers.StaleMove.zh: 内容或选择已改变，请关闭并重新打开移动窗口。
Layers.StaleMove.en: Content or selection changed. Close and reopen Move to.

Layers.Moved.zh: 已移动 {0} 项至 {1}，跳过 {2} 项。

Layers.FlagProcessed.zh: 已修改 {0} 项，跳过 {1} 项（祖先锁定或已是目标状态）。
Layers.FlagProcessed.en: Changed {0}; skipped {1} (ancestor locked or already in this state).

EditingScope.DocumentSettingsHint.zh: 背景、网格与透视设置作用于文档主画布；前景和背景画布使用屏幕平面。
EditingScope.DocumentSettingsHint.en: Background, grid and perspective settings affect the document main canvas; foreground and background canvases use the screen plane.

Canvas.ClickAgainReset.en: Click again to reset the view

GroupCanvas.SnapshotStatus.zh: 源文件不可用 · 使用保存快照

GroupCanvas.SwitchUnavailable.zh: 当前范围不可切换显示模式；请先解除锁定或返回可用范围。
GroupCanvas.SwitchUnavailable.en: This scope cannot switch display mode. Unlock it or return to an available scope.

GroupCanvas.EmbedHint.zh: 转为内嵌 · 保留工程内共享关系
GroupCanvas.EmbedHint.en: Embed · Retain sharing within this project

GroupCanvas.DetachHint.zh: 解除为普通组 · 此实例不再共享内容
GroupCanvas.DetachHint.en: Detach as group · This instance stops sharing content

LayerExperience.NoOccurrence.zh: 当前没有可用的显示实例，请切换独立画布以编辑。
LayerExperience.NoOccurrence.en: No display instance is available. Switch to independent canvas to edit.

LayerExperience.SnapshotRead.zh: 源文件无法读取 · 使用保存快照

LayerExperience.SnapshotFormat.zh: 源文件格式不可用 · 使用保存快照
LayerExperience.SnapshotFormat.en: Source format unavailable · using saved snapshot

LayerExperience.HiddenIndependent.zh: 独立预览可见；工程中被“{0}”隐藏
LayerExperience.HiddenIndependent.en: Visible independently; hidden in the project by “{0}”

LayerExperience.FlagResult.zh: 已修改 {0} 项；{1} 项无需修改；{2} 项因权限跳过。
LayerExperience.FlagResult.en: Changed {0}; {1} already matched; {2} skipped due to permissions.

LayerExperience.Unplaced.zh: 此共享内容尚未放置到工程，请切换独立画布以编辑。
LayerExperience.Unplaced.en: This shared content has not been placed in the project. Switch to independent canvas to edit.

LayerExperience.CyclicTarget.zh: 不能移入自身或所选对象的子级。
LayerExperience.CyclicTarget.en: Cannot move into the selection or its descendants.

LayerExperience.LockedTarget.en: The destination or its ancestor is locked.

LayerExperience.AncestorLockedBrowse.zh: 上级锁定 · 只读浏览
